Partial success means the issuer is reachable, so the losses are concentrated in the gateway hop the code points at. Attempt 3 failing identically rules out a one-off switch error. No session is open, so recovery is a scheduling problem: retry on card after 15m, which is how long gateway faults of this shape usually take to clear. This is the last attempt the stop rule permits, so it is spent after the window rather than inside it.
